title: Fix 339 fence pass
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-records-001 already fixes which lines a code fence exempts and that an unclosed fence hides nothing; this change finds the same closes in a bounded pass instead of rescanning the rest of the text for every unclosed opener, so only code, a test and the changelog change.
acceptance_criteria: With a session body holding many code fence openers that never close, a record write and chough doctor finish in time that grows linearly with the record, not quadratically: each line is visited a bounded number of times. A conflict after those openers is still refused, since an unclosed fence hides nothing, and closed fences, Chough's own sections and the advisory findings behave as before.

answers.constraints: Leif's P2 review comment on #356 and the standing rule 'Yes, for today' set the scope: compute matching fences in a bounded pass, keep the rule that an unclosed fence hides nothing, and add a regression for many unmatched openers. Deltas none; REQ-records-001 already states which lines a fence exempts.
